text:
Alex: hey team — I pushed a new commit that addresses the comments from earlier (fixed nil check, renamed `batchSize` -> `maxBatch`). PTAL when you have a sec. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/984
Lina: thanks — quick skim looks good. did you run the e2e that exercises the shard fallback?
Alex: yup, ran e2e locally and added a unit for the allocator rotation. also updated the changelog entry. CI should run now.
CI Bot: CI started for commit 7f9c2a3 — running unit tests and smoke e2e
Mike: small nit — in allocator.go the comment above rotate() still mentions old behavior. can you update that? otherwise lgtm from me after CI
Alex: good catch, fixed the comment and pushed again (7f9c2a3 -> 6b4d1f0). also kept the old alias in one place for backcompat with a TODO to remove in next release
CI Bot: CI passed — all checks green :white_check_mark: (units: 312, e2e: smoke passed)
Lina: reading local diff now. the TODO is fine but add a short note in the PR description so release knows it's temporary
Alex: added a note under "compatibility" and called out the removal target (v0.9.0). PTAL on that blurb?
Mike: looks fine to me. approving now :+1:
Lina: approved as well. :sparkles:
Ops: Heads up — I'll try to fit this into tomorrow morning's canary at 11:00 PST if no other blockers. ping me if you prefer a different slot.
Alex: thanks! scheduling that works for me. will be on standby during the canary.
Lina: great, congrats on getting this in.
Alex: thanks everyone — merging after canary if all good.
